domain_setup.notes: Public DNS and RDAP returned NXDOMAIN/not found for edithatogo.com on 2026-06-15. Register the root domain or switch this ingress lane to a registered domain before enabling Cloudflare Email Routing.

fallback_routes.activation_condition: Use only if Cloudflare Email Routing cannot reliably parse or route the Courts of NZ subscription messages.
fallback_routes.receiver_contract: Forward provider payloads to the same GitHub repository_dispatch event type after preserving the raw MIME or provider JSON payload.

fallback_routes.activation_condition: Use only if webhook-style inbound delivery is unavailable.
fallback_routes.receiver_contract: Poll a dedicated mailbox through Gmail or IMAP, archive unseen messages through scripts/archive_email_payload.py, and never advance outbound syndication state.
